comments: One bank on the hub: six frames share one scale and the hub at the canvas centre (the 6-bucket / 8-spoke wheel is point symmetric, so the alpha box centre is the hub).

Left off (runtime false): the painted buckets and the rules' platforms visibly disagree. The rules' six 28 px planks sit at radius 40 on a clockwise 270-tick turn; the six frames are 0, 9, 13, 21, 30 and 37 degrees (nothing past 37 of the 60 a bucket repeats in), so the nearest frame is up to about 12 degrees off a platform, the painted paddles are radial where a knight stands on a flat plank, the planks peek out round them, and a knight on a bottom bucket stands in front of the spokes. See the review pictures in the import report.
geometry: The rules own six 28 px bucket platforms at radius 40, one turn in 270 ticks, clockwise; art never moves a bucket or sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: the same wheel turned clockwise about 0, 9, 13, 21, 30 and 37 degrees (uneven, per the producer note).
size_basis: native canvas 96x96, anchor centre (48,48); stage 384x224 at 16 px per tile; a knight is 12x20.
timing: turn 6x45 ticks (30 Hz). Durations are the rules' and live in assets/bannerpeak/slots.json.
